Date: 2023-07-17
Attorney Docket No. 3726071.00275
ABSTRACT
An electrocardiography monitor is provided. A sealed housing includes one
end wider than an opposite end of the sealed housing. Electronic circuitry is provided within the sealed housing. The electronic circuitry includes an electrographic front end circuit to sense electrocardiographic signals and
a micro-controller interfaced to the electrocardiographic front end circuit to sample the electrocardiographic signals. A buzzer within the housing outputs feedback to
a wearer of the sealed housing.
